# ALFRED wave-1 fixtures

`pnfi-2025-q4-first-print.csv` is the unmodified 51-byte response fetched from
the official ALFRED graph endpoint on 2026-08-07 UTC:

`https://alfred.stlouisfed.org/graph/alfredgraph.csv?id=PNFI&vintage_date=2026-02-20&cosd=2025-10-01&coed=2025-10-01`

Its SHA-256 is
`05b9718a7ab180b5f8aa5028dbdc04291f5e76c69ebacd0214239d5c57d4df92`.
It preserves the Q4 2025 first print, 4,378.954 billion dollars at a
seasonally adjusted annual rate, from the 2026-02-20 GDP advance release.

`bea-rd-2025-q4-first-print.csv` is the unmodified 61-byte response fetched
from the same official endpoint on 2026-08-07 UTC:

`https://alfred.stlouisfed.org/graph/alfredgraph.csv?id=Y006RC1Q027SBEA&vintage_date=2026-02-20&cosd=2025-10-01&coed=2025-10-01`

Its SHA-256 is
`1e7e49c3d4c3468182298f1ec511bb38cafbb1a96d0a83a3f62414b729de01f1`.
It preserves the Q4 2025 first print, 885.955 billion dollars at a seasonally
adjusted annual rate, from the 2026-02-20 GDP advance release.
